很多人刚来湾区，先开始记城市名，结果越看越乱。更稳的办法不是先背 San Fra: New arrivals often start memorizing city names and end up more confused. Instead of first learning San Francisco, San Jose, and Fremont by heart, understand the regions. Housing, commuting, airport pickups, secondhand shopping, and moving often involve choosing a whole everyday travel area, not just one city.
为什么先看区域，比先看城市更重要: Why start with regions before cities?
先看区域，能更快排除明显不适合自己的地方。: Starting with regions helps you rule out places that clearly don't fit.
先看区域，找房时不容易只被城市名字带着走。: Start with regions so your housing search isn't driven only by city names.
先看区域，后面再看具体 City Guide 会更有方向。: Understanding the region gives you a clearer direction when reading individual city guides.
先看区域，发求租或找室友时也更容易把需求写清楚。: Understanding regions also helps you write a clearer rental or roommate request.
五大片区可以先这样理解: A starting point for understanding the five areas
旧金山：城市感最强，适合喜欢步行、公共交通和经典街区的人。: San Francisco: the most urban option, suited to people who enjoy walking, public transit, and classic neighborhoods.
半岛 Peninsula：可结合 Caltrain 和 SamTrans 站点比: Peninsula: Compare housing around Caltrain and SamTrans stops, focusing on your destinations and last-mile connections.
南湾 South Bay：工作、学校和华人生活圈都很完整，很多科技公司用户会优先: South Bay: A broad mix of jobs, schools, and Chinese community resources makes this a starting point for many tech workers.
东湾 East Bay：区域差异大，预算、空间和社区感的选择面更广。: East Bay: wide differences between areas, with more varied choices in budget, space, and neighborhood feel.
北湾 North Bay：更偏自然和慢节奏，适合有车、生活半径不靠市中心的人。: North Bay: More nature and a slower pace, often suited to people with cars whose routines don't center on downtown.
不同人群，通常会先看哪一片: Which area do different groups usually consider first?
没有车、想先住得方便：优先看旧金山或交通节点强的区域。: No car and want a convenient start? Look first at San Francisco or areas with strong transit connections.
通勤在旧金山和南湾之间：优先看半岛。: Commuting between San Francisco and the South Bay: Consider the Peninsula first.
在 South Bay 上班或长期生活：优先看南湾。: Working or living long-term in the South Bay: start with the South Bay.
预算敏感、愿意研究路线：可以认真看东湾。: Budget-conscious and willing to research routes: Take a serious look at the East Bay.
喜欢自然、节奏慢、有车：可再看北湾。: Prefer nature, a slower pace, and have a car? Consider the North Bay.
别把“地图上看起来不远”当成真实体验。跨湾、过桥、换乘、找停车位，都会把日常时间: Don't mistake “close on the map” for the real experience. Crossing the bay or a bridge, making transfers, and finding parking all add time.
刚来湾区，最实用的选区逻辑: A practical way for newcomers to choose an area
不要先问“哪座城市最好”，先问这几个问题：你主要去哪里？预算大概多少？有没有车？: Instead of asking “Which city is best?” first ask: where do you mainly need to go, what's your budget, do you have a car, can you share a home, and do you need public transit? Answering those questions makes suitable areas clearer.
如果你现在还分不清自己该看哪一片，先把“公司或学校在哪、有没有车、预算大概多少、: If you're unsure which region to consider, write down where you work or study, whether you have a car, your rough budget, and whether you're open to roommates before opening the map.
